notes:
More reliable sending: the app now clicks the message button with the mouse, like
a person. Before, LinkedIn sometimes opened the full messaging page instead of the
small chat window, where the input field could be covered and some contacts failed
every time. If the field is still covered, the app types into it directly without
having to click it.

After sending, the app checks that LinkedIn really sent the message. If the
browser crashed in the meantime, it is restarted before sending.
